rules: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.
Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).
Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.
Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.
You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.
Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.
Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)
Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.
Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.
Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.
Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.
Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)
Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.
Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)
Discard 1 Energy card attached to your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.
Draw 2 cards.
Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.
Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.
Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.
Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

rules: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.
Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.
You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.
Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.
Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)
Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.
Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.
Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Oddish.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.effect: Remove a number of damage counters from Oddish equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Oddish has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

flavorText: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.effect: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Onix.

flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Pikachu.

flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shuckle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Slowpoke but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he of she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular.

attacks.name: Scary Face
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, until the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack or retreat.

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Sudowoodo.

flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to Sunkern.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.effect: Remove a number of damage counters from Sunkern equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Sunkern has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

flavorText: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Totodile.

flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Totodile during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

rules: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top 3 cards of it. If at least 2 of those cards share the same name, put all the ones with that name into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck. If none of them do, shuffle all 3 into your deck.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

Whenever an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card discards another player's non-Colorless Energy card from a Pokémon, return that Energy card to its owner's hand. (Energy cards that are discarded when that Pokémon is Knocked Out don't count.)
Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
Attach Focus Band to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

If the Pokémon Focus Band is attached to would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. Then, discard Focus Band.
Draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck.

Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of them are Trainer cards, you may show 1 of them to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.
Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile. If you have fewer than 4 basic Energy cards there, take all of them.

Your opponent may choose 5 Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards in his or her discard pile. (If your opponent doesn't have that many, he or she chooses all or none of them.) If your opponent chooses any cards, he or she shuffles them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same, and you can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.
Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

Choose 1 of your opponent's face-down Prizes. Guess whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card face up (and leave it face up). If you guessed right, draw 2 cards.
Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

At any time between turns, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, you may remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry.
Attach Miracle Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

At any time between turns, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, you may remove all those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry. At the start of each turn, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, remove all of those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry.
Shuffle your deck. Then, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.
Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
All damage done by Colorless Pokémon's attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.
Attach Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

At any time between turns, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, you may remove 2 of them and discard Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, remove 2 of them and discard Berry.

If you have any Benched Pokémon, your opponent chooses 1 of them and switches it with your Active Pokémon. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from that Pokémon. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

Your opponent may search his or her deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, you may search your deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto your Bench. Then, each player shuffles his or her deck. (A player can't do any of this if his or her Bench is full.)
Flip a coin. If heads, put an Evolution card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand. If tails, put a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand.

If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's Darkness or has Dark in its name.
Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
Recycle Energy provides Colorless Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
If this card is put into your discard pile from play, return it to your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Spikes
abilities.effect: During your opponent's turn, whenever 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon becomes his or her Active Pokémon, Forretress does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Forretress is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmontop.

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dancelike kicks, you may get drilled hard.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.effect: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

attacks.name: Smog
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Collect Fire
attacks.effect: If there are any Fire Energy cards in your discard pile, choose 1 of them and attach it to Houndour.

flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

attacks.name: Hydrocutter
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to Kabutops. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. You can't flip more than 3 coins in this way.

flavorText: In the water, it tucks its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

attacks.name: Lock-on
attacks.effect: During your next turn, treat any tails flipped when using Magnemite's Electric Bolt attack as if they were heads. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Electric Bolt
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

flavorText: These Pokémon are attracted to electrical emissions and will often follow people using PokéGear.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Frog Song
abilities.effect: Whenever Politoed's attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), if there are more than 3 Poliwags, Poliwhirls, Poliwraths, and/or Politoeds in play (including your opponent's), that attack does 40 more damage (no matter how many heads you get). This power stops working while Politoed is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.effect: Poliwrath does 20 damage to itself.

flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

attacks.name: False Swipe
attacks.effect: Does damage equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded down to the nearest 10).

attacks.name: Double Claw
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

attacks.name: Sketch
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon attacked last turn, and Smeargle was in play during that attack, Smeargle copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack.

flavorText: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Trample
attacks.effect: For each Benched Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

abilities.effect: Whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, that attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on Unown [A]. If you have more than 1 Unown [A] in play, use only 1 [Anger] for each attack.

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.effect: Whenever you attach an Energy card to Eevee, flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Eevee that is the same type as the Energy card you attached to Eevee. Attach that card to Eevee. This counts as evolving Eevee. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Eevee is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

attacks.name: Plunder
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, discard all Trainer cards attached to the Defending Pokémon (before they affect the damage).

flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

abilities.name: Gaze
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has a Pokémon Power. That power stops working until the end of this turn. This effect ends if that Pokémon leaves the Bench.

flavorText: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything else). If tails, your opponent's turn ends.

attacks.name: Secrete Poison
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, whenever your opponent's attack damages Kakuna (even if Kakuna is Knocked Out), your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Kakuna does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 20 or less damage is done to Metapod (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen).

attacks.name: Hatch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Metapod. Then, search your deck for a card that evolves from Metapod and attach that card to Metapod. This counts as evolving Metapod. Shuffle your deck afterward.

flavorText: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

attacks.name: Squeeze
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Spike Barrage
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Omastar. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

flavorText: Apparently, it cracked Shellder's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

attacks.name: Belly Drum
attacks.effect: Put 3 damage counters on Poliwhirl. If this doesn't Knock Out Poliwhirl, search your deck for 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to Poliwhirl. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Poliwhirl but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

flavorText: The swirl on its belly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

attacks.name: Dust Devil
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each non-Fighting Pokémon in play. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage if exactly 1 is heads, or 20 more damage if exactly 2 are heads, or 40 more damage if exactly 3 are heads, or 80 more damage if all 4 are heads.

flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.effect: Whenever a Metal Pokémon damages 1 of your Pokémon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown [M] in play. (This power works even if Unown [M] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

attacks.name: Energy Cycle
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Attach that Energy card to that Pokémon.

flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.effect: Caterpie does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

attacks.name: Work Together
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Omanyte, Omastar, Kabuto, and Kabutops on your Bench.

abilities.name: Revive Friends
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card named Kabuto and put it on your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. Treat the new Kabuto as a Basic Pokémon. This power can't be used if Kabuto is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed (or if your Bench is full).

flavorText: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Mareep does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused

flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Revive Fossil
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. Treat that card as a Basic Pokémon. This power can't be used if Omanyte is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed (or if your Bench is full).

flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

attacks.name: Burst
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, Pineco does 40 damage to itself and 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.effect: Look at your opponent's hand.

flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It spins a web using fine – but durable – thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

attacks.name: Nap Time
attacks.effect: Remove all damage counters from Teddiursa. Teddiursa is now Asleep.

flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

attacks.name: Smash Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything else). If tails, your opponent's turn ends.

abilities.name: [Engage]
abilities.effect: When you play Unown [E] from your hand, your opponent may shuffle his or her hand into his or her deck and then draw 4 cards. Either way, you may shuffle your hand into your deck and draw 4 cards.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Increase]
abilities.effect: When you play Unown [I] from your hand, you may search your deck for a card with Unown in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use this power if your Bench is full.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

abilities.name: [Observe]
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 5 cards from the top of your opponent's deck and put them back in the same order.

flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

attacks.name: Spike Stab
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

attacks.name: Slime
attacks.effect: If an attack would do damage to Wooper during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, prevent all damage to Wooper from that attack. (Any other effects of that attack happen.)

flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil and put it onto your Bench or put a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil from your hand onto your Bench. Either way, treat the new card as a Basic Pokémon. If you searched your deck, shuffle it. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)
Choose 1 of your evolved Pokémon. Take the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon and put it into your hand. (You can't evolve a Pokémon the turn you devolve it.)
Search your deck for a card with Unown in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)
Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wave
attacks.effect: Choose a type of Energy other than Colorless attached to Mew. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon of that type (including Benched Pokémon). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

attacks.name: Bawl
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

attacks.name: Strange Scent
attacks.effect: Each player flips a coin. Each player who gets heads chooses a total of 3 damage counters from among his or her Pokémon and removes them. (If the player's Pokémon have fewer total damage counters than that, he or she removes all of them.)

flavorText: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

attacks.name: Sharp Teeth
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

flavorText: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Ledyba.

flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

attacks.name: Tempting Eyes
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Butterfree. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Rainbow Powder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

attacks.name: Tentacle Grip
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Tentacruel. For each heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

attacks.name: Squirt
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

attacks.name: Gentle Song
attacks.effect: If Lapras has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

attacks.name: Sharpshooter
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Grass Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

attacks.name: Revelation
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

attacks.name: Lick Wounds
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Tongue Stretch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

attacks.name: Paradise Pollen
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from Vileplume (1 if it only has 1). Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Horrid Pollen
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

attacks.name: Rampage
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Primeape. Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).

flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

attacks.name: Attract Current
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, you may search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Lightning Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Gigavolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Softboiled
abilities.effect: When you play Blissey from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 8 damage counters from Blissey. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from Blissey. Either way, if Blissey has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

flavorText: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

attacks.name: Psychic Damage
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Time Travel
abilities.effect: If an opponent's attack would Knock Out Celebi, flip a coin. If heads, Celebi isn't Knocked Out and you shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power doesn't work if Celebi is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

attacks.name: Triggered Poison
attacks.effect: If your opponent attaches an Energy card to the Defending Pokémon during his or her next turn, that Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Cross Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

attacks.name: Present
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, this attack does 40 damage. If exactly 2 are heads, remove 3 damage counters from the Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. If all 3 are heads, this attack does 60 damage. If all 3 are tails, remove all damage counters from the Defending Pokémon.

flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

attacks.name: Searing Flames
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to Entei or this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.effect: When you play Entei from your hand, you may discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If you have fewer cards in your deck than that, discard all of them.) If any of those are Fire Energy cards, attach them to any of your Fire Pokémon of your choice. Using this power ends your turn.

flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.effect: You may search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to Ho-Oh. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

attacks.name: Dark Flame
attacks.effect: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing. If there are any Darkness Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Houndoom.

attacks.name: Black Fang
attacks.effect: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Darkness Energy attached to Houndoom. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

attacks.name: Evolutionary Spore
attacks.effect: Choose any number of your Hoppips and Skiplooms. Then, for each Pokémon you chose in this way, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and attach it to that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving those Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

flavorText: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.effect: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Magneton.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Power
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, or Dark Magnetons and attach it to a different 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, and Dark Magnetons. This power can't be used if Magneton is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

attacks.name: Night Eyes
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Perish Song
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep and was attacked with Night Eyes during your last turn, it is Knocked Out.

flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

attacks.name: Delta Beam
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose whether the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Energy Converter
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and choose an Energy type. Treat that Energy card as that type until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Porygon2 becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, the Energy card goes back to its original type.

flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

attacks.name: Lightning Tackle
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Raikou does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Lightning Burst
abilities.effect: Whenever you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. This power stops working while Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

attacks.name: Aurora Wave
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If only 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Crystal Body
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, other than damage, done to Suicune. This power stops working while Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Aerodactyl. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

abilities.name: Prehistoric Memory
abilities.effect: Whenever an Evolved Pokémon attacks (even if it's your opponent's), it can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card attached to it. It still has to pay for that attack's Energy cost. This power stops working while Aerodactyl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

attacks.name: Psychic Leaf
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads. Remove a number of damage counters from Celebi equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If Celebi has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

flavorText: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

attacks.name: Mega Flame
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 Fire Energy card from Entei, if it has any.

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.effect: As long as Entei is your Active Pokémon, Entei and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Entei. (This power works even if Entei is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each type of Basic Energy card, if any, attached to Ho-Oh.

flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

attacks.name: Genetic Memory
attacks.effect: Use any attack from Kingdra's Basic Pokémon card or Evolution card. (Kingdra doesn't have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon, if any, and discard it. If both are tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

attacks.name: Aerowing
attacks.effect: You may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.effect: You may discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Raichu. If you do, this attack does 80 damage.

flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

attacks.name: Lightning Spark
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.effect: As long as Raikou is your Active Pokémon, Raikou and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Raikou. (This power works even if Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Skarmory.

flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Core Stream
attacks.effect: Choose an Energy type other than Colorless. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon with any Energy cards of that type attached to it. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

flavorText: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.effect: As long as Sudowoodo is your Active Pokémon, it copies all of the Defending Pokémon's attacks, including their costs. This power can't be used if Sudowoodo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

attacks.name: Crystal Wave
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage and, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.effect: As long as Suicune is your Active Pokémon, Suicune and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Suicune. (This power works even if Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

attacks.name: Tail Shock
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.effect: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Bite
attacks.effect: If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Golbat equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Golbat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Either way, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.effect: Don't apply Resistance.

flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

attacks.name: Freezing Kiss Goodnight
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Strange Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

attacks.name: Blinding Light
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

attacks.name: Make a Mess
attacks.effect: Discard up to 2 Trainer cards from your hand. This attack does 20 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

attacks.name: All Out
attacks.effect: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 130 more damage.

flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

attacks.name: Beckon
attacks.effect: Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

attacks.name: Brilliant Search
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sensitive Ray
attacks.effect: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

attacks.name: Zzzap Touch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

attacks.name: Wonder Ray
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by any Pokémon that has an Ability.

flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

attacks.name: Bright Horns
attacks.effect: This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn.

abilities.name: Path of Life
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

abilities.name: Mysterious Buzz
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Fairy Pokémon in play.

flavorText: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

attacks.name: Dream's Touch
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, your opponent shuffles all Energy from it into their deck.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Let's Snuggle & Fall
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dream Fear-GX
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Charmed Charm
abilities.effect: Whenever you attach a Pokémon Tool card that has "Fairy Charm" in its name from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

attacks.name: Dream Away
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Wonder Shine
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

attacks.name: Healing Pirouette
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sympathetic Slap
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

attacks.name: Powerful Slap
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Happiness Supplement
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

abilities.name: Almighty Evolution
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put any Stage 1 card from your hand onto this Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or the turn this Pokémon was put into play.

flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Enhanced Horns
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

attacks.name: Stunning Likeness
attacks.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may use the effect of a Supporter card you find there as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

attacks.name: Milk Cannon
attacks.effect: Reveal any number of Moomoo Milk cards in your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pelagic Blade
attacks.effect: This Pokémon can't use Pelagic Blade during your next turn.

attacks.name: Lost Purge-GX
attacks.effect: Put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

attacks.name: Tongue Smack
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

abilities.name: Unit Color 1
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy GrassFireWater attached to it, it is a Grass, Fire, and Water Pokémon.

flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

abilities.name: Unit Color 3
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy FightingDarknessFairy attached to it, it is a Fighting, Darkness, and Fairy Pokémon.

flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

attacks.name: Send Back
attacks.effect: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

abilities.name: Mountain Pass
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your hand, you may reveal it. If you do, look at the top card of your opponent's deck and put this Pokémon in the Lost Zone. If that card is a Supporter card, you may put it in the Lost Zone. If your opponent has no cards in their deck, you can't use this Ability.

flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

attacks.name: Heat Beak
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Giganticannon
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon evolved during this turn, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

attacks.name: Air Slash

flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

attacks.name: Ice Edge

attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

attacks.name: Double Freeze

flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.effect: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

attacks.name: Muddy Bolt
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has any Fighting Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

attacks.name: Happy Return
attacks.effect: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

attacks.name: Extended Damagriiigus
attacks.effect: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

attacks.name: Synchro Shot
attacks.effect: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

abilities.name: Distorted Future
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 3 cards.

flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

attacks.name: Oceanic Gloom
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 80 more damage.

abilities.name: Oceanic Curse
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards or Pokémon Tool cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less.

flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

attacks.name: Vengeful Cannon
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Fighting Pokémon.

flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

attacks.name: Rising Chop
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

abilities.name: Ancient Wing
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

attacks.name: Smash Uppercut
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

attacks.name: Ruffians Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Darkness Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

attacks.name: Gunk Shot
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Dark Bite
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

attacks.name: Special Fang
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.

flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

attacks.name: Gold Breaker
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.effect: Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.effect: Move a Basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

abilities.name: Healing Leaves
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

attacks.name: Healing Wrapping
attacks.effect: Heal 100 damage from each of your Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.effect: If you have Karrablast in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.effect: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Emerald Blade
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

abilities.name: Inferno Fandango
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

attacks.name: Brighten and Burn
attacks.effect: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

attacks.name: Incendiary Pillar
attacks.effect: If you have 10 or more Basic Fire Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.name: Burn It All Up
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

attacks.name: Licking Catch
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Fire Pokémon and Basic Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

attacks.name: Energized Shell
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energized Slash
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
